Name: 账金小使魔
Description: 每2回合消耗{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}提供伤害和护盾；若你有{GoldExp_goldexp_debt}，额外抽牌并加深债务。
Description_zh-Hant: 每2回合消耗{GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold}提供傷害和護盾；若你有{GoldExp_goldexp_debt}，額外抽牌並加深債務.
Description_en: Every 2 rounds, spends {GoldExp_goldexp_false_gold} for damage and Block. If you have {GoldExp_goldexp_debt}, also draw and gain more Debt.
Tips: 它会把账本合上，然后把欠款念给敌人听。
Tips_zh-Hant: 它會把帳本合上，然後把欠款念給敵人聽。
Tips_en: It closes the ledger before naming the debt.
